reviews.text:
App stopped working when I needed it. I like CityPASS. It offered a good value. But, when I needed to use the pass, the app was unavailable for 2 hours. The screen was just white. I reset my phone. Connected to wifi. Nothing seemed to work. You should take screenshots of your tickets to ensure you can use them in case the app is down like it was for me.

Update (8/12/24), Dev responded that Azure, their cloud provider, had outages during this time. I appreciate the comment as I felt stuck in a city without options. It’s understandable that their cloud provider was down. Perhaps you could add something to Apple wallet or something offline if you haven’t already for people unable to connect to your site. Either way, enjoyed the pass, and was VERY glad I took pictures of the tickets prior to being able to connect to the app.
